subject: general
question: In which of the following states of India is the Dree festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is__ __**Arunachal Pradesh**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The Dree Festival is an agricultural festival celebrated by the Apatani tribes of Arunachal Pradesh
 
• Every year, it is observed on the 5th of July with great fervour and zest by the Apatanis.
 
• The impressive celebration takes place at Ziro in Arunachal Pradesh
 
• Dree is celebrated in order to bring a bountiful harvest season, hence, Apatani offers prayers to the four Gods they follow - Tamu, Harniang, Metii, and Danyi.
 
• This three-day-long agricultural festival is joyously celebrated with traditional clothes worn by women and children.​
